simple.summary: אֹרֶב (ʼôreb) means wait. First listed occurrence: Jer 9 7.

definitions.full: H696. oreb [ אֹ֫רֶב ] noun [masculine] ambuscade only figurative — a. אָרְבּוֺ יָשִׂים Jer 9:7 i.e. he planneth treachery. b. אָרְבָּם their intrigue Hosea 7:6 compare Now p.126 .
